about_the_game:
Harness the power of symbols sealed in scrolls of mystic arts to defeat the monster!
Spin your scroll and use the symbols that appear to strike down monsters.

Defeat monster and collect symbol fragments to create your own custom scroll!
By defeating monster, you’ll earn symbol fragments that can be used to enhance your scroll.
Carefully consider the combination of symbols you have, and strategically place them based on their synergy and scroll type.

 

Upgrade your symbols and unlock powerful new abilities!
Use the money you earn during your journey to strengthen symbols and grant them unique effects.
Each symbol can be enhanced to unleash different powers through upgrades.

 

Upgrade your scroll with parts dropped by monster and unlock new abilities!
Some monster drop special scroll components when defeated.
By using these parts, you can restore a portion of your scroll’s original power.
Gain access to unique abilities—such as symbol placement, combat enhancements, or reuse mechanics—and expand your tactical options.

 

Defeat the mighty lords of each domain!
Each map features a dominant monster—the lord of the area—who poses a serious threat to the protagonist.
These powerful foes boast higher stats and unique abilities compared to regular enemies.
Overcome them to earn special rewards and build an even more powerful scroll!

The scroll (slot machine) featured in this game is a magical tool that allows the use of mystical arts. It has no connection whatsoever to real money, gambling, or any form of actual currency, and does not require any payments to use!

name: Spin Of Dosul

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 730
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Spin of Dosul is a new roguelike deck-building game that combines slot machine mechanics with inventory management. Test your luck alongside an adorable Dokkaebi! Collect symbols and sacred relics to build your own scroll and defeat monsters on your journey back to the real world.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese
